personal.title: A personal account
personal.detail: For yourself. You will be asked for your name and your DNI.

organization.title: An organization
organization.detail: For a company. You will be asked for its legal name and CUIT.

confirmEmail.title: Confirm your email
confirmEmail.missingToken: Open the link from the confirmation email; this page needs the token it carries.
confirmEmail.success: Your address is confirmed. Sign in to continue.

organization.title: Register an organization
organization.acknowledgement: If that address can register, we have sent it a confirmation link. Check the inbox.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.acknowledgement: If that address can sign in, we have sent it a reset link. Check the inbox.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.missingToken: Open the link from the reset email; this page needs the token it carries.
reset.success: Your password is set. Sign in to continue.

change.title: Change your password
change.success: Your password is changed. Your other devices have been signed out.

external.description: Linking is something you do from here, never something that happens because an address matched. You always keep at least one way to sign in.
external.refused: That did not complete. Nothing was changed.
external.empty: This deployment has no sign-in provider configured, so there is nothing to link here yet.
external.onlyWayIn: — this is your only way to sign in. Set a password before you unlink it.

externalReturn.title: Finishing up
externalReturn.refused: Nothing was changed. You can try again.

register.title: Set up your account
register.success: Check your email. If that invitation is still open, we have sent you what you need to continue.

accept.title: Accept your invitation
accept.precondition: Sign in with the invited address first.
accept.refreshFailed: Your membership was saved, but your access could not be refreshed. <signIn>Sign in to continue</signIn>.

member.title: Invite a member
member.noOrganization: Choose an organization first. An invitation belongs to one organization, and this session is not in one.
member.rolesRefused: You cannot see this organization’s roles, so there are none to offer here.
member.noRolesToOffer: This organization has no roles to offer yet.
member.invitationsRefused: You cannot see this organization’s invitations.
member.noInvitations: No invitation has been sent yet.
member.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw the invitation to {{email}}? Their link stops working.

account.title: Your account
account.description: Deactivating ends all your sessions and prevents sign-in. Your memberships stay recorded. To return, request an email link and enter your current password.
account.lastAdministrator: If you are the last administrator or Platform owner, give someone else that responsibility first.
account.notAllowed: You do not have permission to deactivate this account.
account.proofWithPassword: {{proof}} To return after deactivation, you will need a password. <setPassword>Set a password</setPassword>.
account.confirmDeactivation: I understand that this ends all my sessions and stops sign-in.

request.description: Use this if you deactivated your own account. This cannot lift an administrative suspension.
request.deactivated: Your account is deactivated. All your sessions have ended.
request.success: If that account can be reactivated, we have sent a link to its email address. Check the inbox.
request.returning: Returning requires your current password. <resetPassword>Reset or set a password</resetPassword> if needed, then request a reactivation link.

reactivate.success: Your account is active again. Sign in to continue.
reactivate.missingToken: Open the link from your reactivation email; this page needs its token.
reactivate.nextSteps: <resetPassword>Reset or set a password</resetPassword> if needed. Then <requestReactivation>request a new reactivation link</requestReactivation>.

members.noOrganization: Choose an organization first. Members belong to one organization, and this session is not in one.
members.description: You can only give somebody a role you could have built yourself, and the organization always keeps at least one administrator. The owner cannot be suspended or removed — transfer the organization first.
members.providerProof: You have no password here. Changing roles or handing the organization over asks {{provider}} to confirm it is you.
members.empty: Nobody belongs to this organization yet.
members.transferConfirm: Give this organization to {{name}}? You will stop being its owner.
members.rolesRefused: You cannot see this organization’s roles, so there are none to give here.
members.noRolesToGive: This organization has no roles to give yet.

register.title: Set up your personal account
register.organizationInstead: Registering a company instead? <organization>Register an organization</organization>.

dispute.title: Correct this document
dispute.success: The correction was sent for review. Nothing about your account changes while it is open.
dispute.alreadyOpen: A correction is already being reviewed for this document.
dispute.description: An operator reviews the correction. Your account keeps working while it is open.
dispute.typedWrongAtSignup: I typed it wrong when I signed up

context.success: Your personal account was added. Refreshing your access…
context.empty: You have no personal context yet.

roles.noOrganization: Choose an organization first. Roles belong to one organization, and this session is not in one.
roles.description: A role is a label with permissions behind it. You can only put permissions into a role that you hold yourself, and the organization always keeps at least one administrator.
roles.providerProof: You have no password here. Every change asks {{provider}} to confirm it is you.
roles.empty: No roles have been made for this organization yet. The first one is composed below.
roles.name: Name
roles.noneGrantable: You hold no permissions that can be put into a role.

sessions.description: Signing in somewhere else does not sign you out here. Ending a device asks for your password first.
sessions.providerProof: You have no password here. Ending a device asks {{provider}} to confirm it is you.
sessions.noPassword: You signed in with a provider and have no password yet, so there is nothing to prove with. <setPassword>Set a password</setPassword> and this page can end a device.

tenants.title: Choose an organization
tenants.empty: You do not belong to an organization yet.
